caption: The drawing depicts a single object composed of a wide, blue ribbon arranged in an oval shape with its two ends crossing at the top. The ribbon has a soft gradient of shades, transitioning between lighter and darker blue tones, with visible brushstrokes simulating the texture of fabric. At the crossing ends, the ribbon is adorned with decorative elements, including small circular accents and a border of gold or yellowish embroidery along the edges. The lower part of the ribbon is bordered with a section of delicate white lace, featuring floral patterns and scalloped edges, giving a translucent appearance. The composition is centered against a plain, light background.
title: Collar
